reason: E2 directly shows that annealing of Nb-Ta-Ti-Hf-Zr produces short-range clusters with 7–15 nm spacing, supporting the structural premise. However, neither E1 nor E2 provides any evidence linking short-range order to reduced electron scattering or enhanced superconductivity; those mechanistic and outcome premises are unsupported by the cited passages.
